err.backup_folder: The backups folder (saves/_backups) cannot be created or written.
err.backup_protected: The newest backup and the latest automatic one made before a restore are never deleted.
err.backup_write: The backup could not be written. Nothing was changed.
err.cannot_carry: Their inventory has no room for the tablet item.
err.client_no_answer: Their game did not answer. They may be loading or have just left.
err.department_off: Your department is turned off in Crimson-Police. Ask an admin.
err.dept_account_unknown: Renewed-Banking has no society account with that name.
err.dept_builtin: This department is in config.lua: turn it off instead of deleting it.
err.dept_exists: A department with that key already exists.
err.dept_grade_unknown: That supervisor grade does not exist in one of its Qbox jobs.
err.dept_has_rows: This department already has history (runs, officers, commendations or funding): turn it off instead.
err.dept_job_moving: A job can move to another department only while no run or Cross-Department Mission is going.
err.dept_job_taken: One of these jobs already belongs to another department.
err.dept_job_unknown: One of these jobs is not a Qbox job.
err.dept_key: The key must be 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or _. It cannot change later.
err.dept_last: At least one department must stay on.
err.dept_logo_file: The logo file must be a PNG, WebP or SVG file name in logos/ (no folders).
err.dept_logo_url: The logo link must be a direct https:// image link.
err.dept_on_run: Officers of this department are on a run or a Cross-Department Mission. Try again when they are done.
err.desk_size: A desk box must be 0.3 to 5 m on each side.
err.export_folder: The exports folder (saves/exports) cannot be created or written.
err.export_write: The export file could not be written.
err.goal_type: That goal names a mission type that does not exist.
err.has_tablet_item: They already carry the tablet item.
err.history_unknown: That settings change is no longer in the history.
err.import_format: This is not a Crimson-Police settings export.
err.import_nothing: Nothing in this import would change a setting.
err.no_position: Your position could not be read.
err.no_tablet_item_set: No tablet item is set (Settings → Tablet → item).
err.not_left_behind: This storage is in use: nothing to take back.
err.require_item_none: Require the item only works while a tablet item is set.
err.restore_failed: The restore failed part way. Crimson-Police stays locked: restore the automatic backup made just before, then restart.
err.retention_archive: Archive runs after 0 (never) or 3 months and more.
err.retention_audit: Keep the audit log at least 30 days (0 = forever).
err.setting_changed_since: This setting was changed again since. Revert anyway?
err.settings_safe_mode: Crimson-Police started with set cp_settings_safe 1: settings can only be reset until it is removed.
err.storage_folder: The folder must be inside the resource, under saves (for example saves or saves/second).
err.storage_runs_active: Runs or a Cross-Department Mission are going. Try again when they are done.
err.storage_target_empty: That storage holds no Crimson-Police data. Copy your data first, or choose Start empty.
err.theme_contrast: The text would be hard to read on that background (contrast below 4.5:1).
err.upload_busy: You are already uploading a logo. Wait a minute or finish that one.
err.upload_chunk: A part of the picture did not arrive correctly. Try again.
err.upload_expired: The upload took too long. Try again.
err.upload_too_big: The picture is larger than 1 MB.
err.upload_type: Only PNG and WebP pictures can be uploaded.
err.upload_write: The picture could not be saved in logos/.
settings.console.console_only: This command only works in the server console.
settings.console.help: {cmd} settings | settings reset <path> | settings reset all: the settings changed in game (when the Admin UI cannot open)
settings.console.listed: {n} settings changed in game (listed above). Undo one with: {cmd}
settings.console.reset: {path} is back to its config.lua value.
settings.console.reset_all: Every setting changed in game is back to config.lua.
settings.console.usage: Use: settings | settings reset <path> | settings reset all
settings.console_safe_mode: set cp_settings_safe 1: the settings changed in game are ignored for this start (nothing deleted). Remove the line from server.cfg and restart to use them again.
settings.health.safe_mode: Safe start: the settings changed in game are ignored (set cp_settings_safe 1 in server.cfg).
sysadmin.checklist.dispatch_jobs: Each department's job is in sc-dispatch's AllowedJobs.
sysadmin.checklist.police_jobs: Each department's job is in sc-police's PoliceJobs.
sysadmin.checklist.ambulance: sc-ambulance is started (downed officers on a run).
sysadmin.checklist.banking: Renewed-Banking has a society account per department when pay comes from society accounts.
sysadmin.checklist.item: The tablet item is in ox_inventory's items when one is set.
sysadmin.checklist.arena: Crimson-Arena's two no-build zones are kept (System → Integrations).
sysadmin.console.console_only: This command only works in the server console.
sysadmin.console.left_behind: This storage was left behind by a storage switch: nothing is paid or changed here. Use System → Storage → Use this store again only if the other storage is gone.
sysadmin.console.storagemode_help: {cmd} storagemode reset: go back to config.lua's Config.Database at the next start
sysadmin.console.storagemode_reset: The storage chosen in game is cleared. Restart {resource} to use config.lua's Config.Database.
sysadmin.dept_off_notice: {name} is turned off in Crimson-Police. Your history and pay are kept.
sysadmin.health.left_behind: This storage was left behind by a storage switch: nothing is paid or changed here (System → Storage).
sysadmin.health.override: Storage is set in game ({mode} {folder}), not by config.lua. In the console, storagemode reset goes back.
sysadmin.fix.not_police: Their Qbox job is not in any department. Add it to a department in Admin UI → Departments.
sysadmin.fix.department_off: Their department is turned off. Turn it on in Admin UI → Departments.
sysadmin.fix.not_on_duty: They are off duty. Ask them to go on duty (sc-police or sc-multijob).
sysadmin.fix.suspended: They are suspended in Crimson-Police. Lift it in Admin UI → Officers.
sysadmin.fix.suspended_dispatch: They are suspended in SC-Dispatch. Lift it there.
sysadmin.fix.retired: They are retired. Unretire them in Admin UI → Officers.
sysadmin.fix.access_off: That way of opening the tablet is off. Turn it on in Settings → Tablet → access.
sysadmin.fix.in_arena: They are in Crimson-Arena. The tablet opens again when they leave.
sysadmin.fix.no_tablet_item: The tablet item is required and they don't carry one. Use Give tablet item.
sysadmin.fix.refused: The tablet refused them. Check the Config health list.
admin.action.auditExport: Audit log saved to the server
sysadmin.ui.subtitle: Where Crimson-Police keeps its data, backups, Discord webhooks, recent problems and the other resources.
sysadmin.ui.folder_hint: Inside the resource, under saves (for example saves or saves/second).
sysadmin.ui.migrations_pending: {n} migration(s) did not run: check the console at start.
sysadmin.ui.override: The storage was switched in game ({mode} {folder}). config.lua's Config.Database is not used until "CrimsonPoliceAdmin storagemode reset" in the console.
sysadmin.ui.copy_text: Copies every Crimson-Police table from one storage to the other. A copy refuses while runs are going. Copying into the storage in use locks Crimson-Police until you restart it.
sysadmin.ui.copy_confirm_text: Copy every Crimson-Police table now? A target that already holds data is never replaced without Replace.
sysadmin.ui.copy_force_text: This replaces every row in the target with the source's. Payments already made in the target stay paid. Make a backup first.
sysadmin.ui.runs_going: {n} run(s) or a Cross-Department Mission are going: wait until they end.
sysadmin.ui.switch_text: Choose where Crimson-Police keeps its data from the next start. The choice is kept by the server (not in config.lua).
sysadmin.ui.start_empty: Start empty (the target has no Crimson-Police data yet)
sysadmin.ui.switch_step1: Make a backup (Backups → Back up now).
sysadmin.ui.switch_step2: Copy your data to the target (Copy all data).
sysadmin.ui.switch_step3: Switch here. New runs and payments wait from now on.
sysadmin.ui.switch_step4: Restart Crimson-Police from txAdmin or the server console.
sysadmin.ui.switch_confirm: From the next start Crimson-Police uses: {target}. This storage is marked as left behind, so nothing is paid or changed here again. Then restart Crimson-Police.
sysadmin.ui.switch_done: Switched. Restart Crimson-Police now from txAdmin or the server console.
sysadmin.ui.left_behind_title: This storage is no longer in use
sysadmin.ui.left_behind_text: A storage switch moved Crimson-Police to another storage. Nothing is paid or changed here, so nothing can be paid twice. Use this store again only if the other storage is gone.
sysadmin.ui.use_again_text: Only when the storage Crimson-Police switched to is gone for good: pay and changes start here again.
sysadmin.ui.backups_subtitle: The last {keep} are kept, in {folder}. The newest and the latest automatic one are never removed.
sysadmin.ui.delete_text: Delete this backup for good? Type its name to confirm.
sysadmin.ui.backup_holds: Every Crimson-Police table, the custom and edited mission files, uploaded logos and the banned-words file. Never webhook links (they live in server.cfg) or the storage choice.
sysadmin.ui.restore_keeps: A restore keeps the audit log, the settings history, the money switches, department funding and every payment made since: paid stays paid, a given reward stays given.
sysadmin.ui.restore_desc: Backup of {when}. An automatic backup is made first; then Crimson-Police waits for a restart.
sysadmin.ui.restore_money: {runs} run rows and {items} item rewards hold or held money: they keep their state now.
sysadmin.ui.restore_confirm: Restore this backup? An automatic backup is made first. New runs and payments wait until you restart Crimson-Police.
sysadmin.ui.restore_done: Restored. Restart Crimson-Police now from txAdmin or the server console.
sysadmin.ui.webhooks_subtitle: Read only: webhook links are set in server.cfg, never in game.
sysadmin.ui.copy_failed: Could not copy: select the text and press Ctrl+C.
sysadmin.ui.webhooks_note: Paste the line into server.cfg with your webhook link, then restart the server. The link itself is never shown here.
sysadmin.ui.problems_subtitle: The last 200 warnings and errors since the start ({n} in total). Links and passwords are cut out.
sysadmin.ui.resources_subtitle: What Crimson-Police works with. Their settings are their own: this page only shows them.
sysadmin.ui.checklist_note: Crimson-Police never edits another resource: fix these in their own config.
sysadmin.ui.arena_note: Crimson-Arena's rules always apply; its two no-build zones can grow, never shrink or go.
sysadmin.ui.support_subtitle: When this player can't open the tablet or their screen is stuck.
sysadmin.ui.give_item_text: Give this player one tablet item (only when they carry none).
sysadmin.ui.release_text: Close Crimson-Police's tablet, panel focus and pick-up fade on their screen. Nothing of other resources is touched.
sysadmin.ui.step.way: The way ({via}) is on and the item is there
sysadmin.ui.dept_add_desc: A new department starts at 0 this season. Its job must also be in sc-dispatch AllowedJobs and sc-police PoliceJobs.
sysadmin.ui.dept_key_hint: Lower-case letters, digits and _. It can't change later.
sysadmin.ui.dept_grade_hint: This Qbox grade and up are supervisors.
sysadmin.ui.dept_account_hint: The Renewed-Banking account its pay comes from.
sysadmin.ui.dept_jobs_hint: A job belongs to one department only.
sysadmin.ui.dept_logo_url_hint: A direct https:// picture link. It shows each player's IP to that host.
sysadmin.ui.dept_logo_file_hint: A file in logos/ (PNG, WebP or SVG).
sysadmin.ui.dept_watermark: Show the logo behind every screen
sysadmin.ui.dept_upload_hint: PNG or WebP, at most 1 MB. Used after the next restart of Crimson-Police.
sysadmin.ui.upload_done: Logo uploaded. It shows after the next restart.
sysadmin.ui.dept_checklist: Add the job to sc-dispatch AllowedJobs and sc-police PoliceJobs too (Crimson-Police never edits them).
sysadmin.ui.dept_edit_note: Changes apply at once; missions reload. A job moves to another department only while no run is going.
sysadmin.ui.dept_off_text: Turn {name} off? Nobody opens the tablet through it any more. Its history, boards, disputes and unpaid pay stay. Type its short tag to confirm.
sysadmin.ui.dept_delete_text: Delete {name}? Only a department added in game with no history can be deleted. Type its short tag to confirm.
sysadmin.ui.desks_text: {n} mission desk(s). Changes apply at once on every player's game.
sysadmin.ui.desk_add_desc: The desk goes where you stand, facing the way you face.
sysadmin.ui.desk_prop_hint: A prop only that player sees, or empty for none.
sysadmin.ui.desk_move_here: Move it to where I stand
sysadmin.ui.export_subtitle: Every setting changed in game as one text, to keep or move to another server. It holds no webhook links.
sysadmin.ui.import_subtitle: Paste an export. You see every change first; locked settings and unknown ones are skipped, money switches stay off.
sysadmin.ui.import_confirm: Save these {n} changes? Each is checked again as it is saved.
sysadmin.ui.revert_again: This setting was changed again since this change. Revert anyway?
sysadmin.ui.points_hint: A change applies to runs that end after it.
sysadmin.ui.points_text: This is a points value. It applies to runs that end after the change; runs going now may end with either value; past rows keep their points. A notice goes to the flags webhook.
sysadmin.ui.safe_title: Safe start: settings changed in game are ignored
sysadmin.ui.safe_text: set cp_settings_safe 1 is in server.cfg. Settings can only be reset now. Remove the line and restart to use them again.
sysadmin.ui.audit_by_player: Show every character of this player
sysadmin.ui.audit_part_desc: Part {part} of {parts} ({n} rows in all, 5000 per part).
